title: MLE: Use dedicated mle.aux_sec fields for Auxiliary Security Header
description:
Allow passing a custom Auxiliary Security Header registration table to
dissect_ieee802154_aux_sec_header_and_key_with_hf(), and register dedicated
mle.aux_sec.* fields in the MLE dissector. This prevents MLE auxiliary
security header fields from colliding with wpan.aux_sec.* fields.

commits_data.message:
MLE: Use dedicated mle.aux_sec fields for Auxiliary Security Header

Allow passing a custom Auxiliary Security Header registration table to
dissect_ieee802154_aux_sec_header_and_key_with_hf(), and register dedicated
mle.aux_sec.* fields in the MLE dissector. This prevents MLE auxiliary
security header fields from colliding with wpan.aux_sec.* fields.
